Batman Beyond - Return of the Joker.name: Batman Beyond: Return of the Joker
Batman Beyond - Return of the Joker.summary: Batman Beyond: Return of the Joker (also known as Batman of the Future: Return of the Joker in Europe and Australia) is a 2000 American direct-to-video animated film featuring the comic book superhero Batman and his archenemy, the Joker. It is set in the continuity of the animated series Batman Beyond, in which Bruce Wayne has retired from crime fighting, giving the mantle of Batman to high school student Terry McGinnis, and serves as a sequel to both Batman: The Animated Series and The New Batman Adventures. As in the TV series, Will Friedle and Kevin Conroy star as Terry McGinnis and Bruce Wayne, respectively. Mark Hamill, who played the Joker opposite Conroy in Batman: The Animated Series and The New Batman Adventures, reprises his role.

Casper - Friends Around the World.name: Casper: Friends Around the World
Casper - Friends Around the World.summary:
Casper's friends have been hexed by an evil spell! The king of ghosts has created an imprisoning device that sends them to different locations across the globe. You must help Casper rescue his friends, but you only have the first ten map pages. If you can find the rest, they will each lead you to a friend.

Collect the pieces of the device that sent your friends away by defeating three evil bosses. If you can manage to find everything in the game, then you'll advance to a special level in the lost city of Atlantis. Watch out for your uncles and tourists, though, because they will make your journey most difficult.

Make Casper jump on umbrellas and trees to reach high places, while using his special ability to levitate to avoid pitfalls and water. You can also make him turn into a parachute to glide down to the surface and duck to avoid flying objects. Ghostly Spheres can be thrown to eliminate apparitions and pumpkin bombs.

CRW - Counter Revolution War.name: CRW: Counter Revolution War
CRW - Counter Revolution War.summary: A Japanese turn-based strategy game published for the PlayStation in 1996.

Refrain Love - Anata ni Aitai.name: Refrain Love: Anata ni Aitai
Refrain Love - Anata ni Aitai.summary: A dating sim where you play as a college student who happens to live right by the campus. It's summer and you're going to America for Christmas, but you'd love to get a woman before then.Your three buddies Kousuke the jock, Tetsuya the DJ, Taizo the nerd and you vow to find a girlfriend before Christmas time. You already know some girls, so it shouldn't be a problem. But you have been having weird dreams of some mystery girl and when a walk in the park leads you to find a girl that looks suspiciously like the one of your dreams, you find that maybe you do have chance with the ladies. But, let's face it. You have to juggle part time jobs, romance, and seeing your dude friends. Welcome to Refrain Love.

Simple 1500 Series Vol. 56 - The Sniper.name: Simple 1500 Series Vol. 56: The Sniper
Simple 1500 Series Vol. 56 - The Sniper.summary:
An entry in the Simple 1500 series for PlayStation where players are challenged to snipe targets. A number of missions will give players the ability to choose their sniping position and the time of day they choose to execute their hit.

Despite being released as a Japan-exclusive, the game would receive a sequel with an official English release; 2004's The Sniper 2 for the PlayStation 2.

Super Adventure Rockman.name: Super Adventure Rockman
Super Adventure Rockman.summary: Super Adventure Rockman is an interactive movie game and prime spin-off for the classic Mega Man series of video games from Capcom. Its gameplay is a combination of adventure game and shooting game. The game alternates between animated cutscenes, making decisions from a list of text options or arrows, and fighting in a first-person shooter mode.
